nom: The INKEY List 15% Vitamin C & EGF Brightening Serum

avis.texte: I have almost used mine up. It lasted 4+ months. I could definitely see results drom this one product. I had been using very expensive products and was trying to fet away from that. Once adding this to my cheaper routin…huge change! Love it and the price.

This product brightens, but it can result in whiteheads. I have sensitive/combination skin that generally is blemish-free. Within a week of using this 15% Vitamin C & EGF Brightening Serum, whiteheads began to appear on my forehead, so I had to stop.

avis.titre: Eh - much better options out there
avis.texte: I had high hopes for this affordable serum with 15% vit C but its a definite no. Its too light - almost no feel on the skin which could be good but i was expecting some moisturing/hydrating from it. Every ither vit c serum ive used adds some glow. This feels like nothing on your skin. Which wouldnt be so bad - especially in summer - but the smell is terrible. I cant get over it. It does dissipate but for the few minutes its noticeable, its awful. Too late to return so im using it latered with a moisturizer that smells better.
I have a very sensitive skin and only few products suit me and doesn't cause irritation and this was one of those few, im loving it soo far.

This serum works very well but it has the worst designed packaging I've ever used. The pump doesnt work unless you slam the bottom on the counter or put a paperclip in the bottom. How has this company not figured out a pump design that works?
Good and hydrating Vitamin C, soft for my sensitive skin and does the job well. I'm on my second bottle. Hoping there might be a sligthly stronger one with the tetrahexyldecyl in it!
My first try and I immediately knew I was going to love this. My face feels and looks great.

I tried this 15% vitamin C serum and, while it didn't make a big difference on my skin, I did notice a slight brightening effect. It feels nice to apply and absorbs well, but the results weren't as noticeable as I expected.

It smells very nice and is not greasy and does not feel uncomfortable and heavy and does not sting. It feels good and comfortable and light as though nothing on yet is healing skin. Also the pump bottle keeps it fresh and stable and does not get dark right away or at all hopefully. I have only tried twice now and hopefully it stays fresh for a long time because I have to buy in packs so not to order back and forth because of people on the street. Please be careful. Thank you
Pleasantly surprised with the feel of the product on my skin. Only been in use 30 days. Seems to be helping a little.
I am in love of that serum. In just 2weeks, my skin is radiant as ever. The texture is perfect. Non sticky and very light. Absorbed quickly into the skin.
This is a very good serum that I keep repurchasing. A must for a glowing skin
Love the feel and texture of this serum. I have been using it for a few weeks now and have noticed a brighter complexion and improved texture.

avis.titre: Using this as my Vit C product
avis.texte: So far so good, no irritation. I use this in the morning as my Vit C product before moisturizer and sunscreen. This is a serum and I like that there's a ton of product in the container.
Love this product ...absorbs well and gas really brightened my skin

I bought this for my sister to try out since she wants to get rid of hyperpigmentation. She used this for a month and felt like her skin looked healthier/less dull, and I noticed her hyperpigmentation lightened up after a while.
I've tried several different vitamin c products before and they were too strong but this is amazing! Will definitely buy again

avis.titre: Love the brightening, dont love the piling!
avis.texte: I introduced this to my AM routine about 3 months ago now. I noticed straight away that once I applied my usual SPF and any make up, it would start to pill and would continue to do so throughout the day! I do t always wear make up but I wear SPF and I dont want the pilling effect. I love the serum itself and I apply a moisturiser afterwards. I live the appearance it gives my skin though!
I didn't see a lot of difference on my skin especially on my acne spots so i expected more
I tried a bottle, saw a difference, took a break and my skin definitely wasn't as clear. Back on it and my skin looks much better. Great for the price.
I've been using this serum for about a month now and I can't truthfully say I've seen super noticeable results, but I feels nice on the skin. Very lightweight.
Not sure about the smell and IMO the product was too orange which made me think it had oxidized

I have been ordering this regularly for about 2.5 years or more. Sometimes it arrives oxidized (the colour has changed to yellow). I find this frustrating because it's essentially ineffective in that state.

Skin Type: Dry, freckles, not too sensitive Acne Type: cystic, hormonal, congested chin This Vit. C serum has been working well for me as others have made me break out. I am almost done with a bottle, and though I do notice brightness, I also use other products in tandem. I am also VERY freckly and it does fade them (so there is proof it works). The only con for me is that it's very liquid-y. I am careful with my layering + I have not had any issues with pilling. I have been mixing a drop of a raw/neutral face oil for a smidge more control with smoothing it on before I move on to heavier serums. I will also say from a clinical perspective; the technology of using EGF along with the vit. c, in addition to the price-point, makes it a no-brainer. Would buy again.
Works really well, visibly brightens skin. Texture is more watery than other serums but I prefer this as it makes it easier to layer with no pilling :)
I am starting to notice a difference in my skin. A bit more luminous, a bit less scars. I love it!

I really love this serum. I'm on my third bottle and my skin has never looked so clear, glory and revitalised. I'm getting loads of compliments and people asking if I have had "anything done". Will never be without it.
Good serum I use every morning. And hasn't caused me any problems like other vitamin c serums have . Feels tacky when first goes on but after 1 min it's fine

avis.titre: Might like the product - not the bottle
avis.texte: This packaging is horrific. My first one was delivered nearly empty, and I threw the last 1/4 in the garbage as I couldn't get the pump to work. Got a replacement bottle (thanks INKEY), but again, the pump is horrific. The serum itself is good and goes a long ways... once you get it out of the infuriating pump.

avis.titre: Quite a nice one this one
avis.texte: Feels good and light, absorbs into my skin quickly and it's not sticky at all. I can't say I have noticed a huge difference to my skin as yet, it's only been 4 weeks but it is definitely one I'm going to keep in my morning routine for now.
Since using this product I see my skin texture as more even and it's very glowy. I'm on my second bottle!
I don't know why this magic works. It brightens my skin and makes my skin look smoother and younger. I layer it after my serum and before my moisturizer. Love LOVE!
Very slow action. I'll keep using it and try to be more consistent.

Lovely texture to this serum. Not as watery as most Vitamin C serums. The waiting 10 minutes before putting anything else on is not always possible, but I try. Tbh, I never see that 'Vitamin C glow' that others talk about, but there is enough science to back up the use of one in my routine. Affordable, layerable serum.
I have been using this serum for a few years and it has really helped improve my skin to e

avis.titre: full points for vitamic C but plant based EFGs?
avis.texte: I need an antioxidant in my skin routine and this light watery vitamin C serum is amazing. And of course EFGs are essential, however I am a bit thoughtful about whether plant based EFGs actually work well as the research only published for human or lab made EFGs. Not sure but I love the texture and the serum overall. And the price is worth it.

avis.titre: I like this vitamin C serum
avis.texte: 2nd product I bought from Inkey. Nice add to my daily routine. It gives me brighter skin

This is a lightweight serum that absorbs into my skin very quickly. The pump disperses enough serum and works well. I brought this vitamin C serum as I have dark marks. After using this serum for the past 3 months I've noticed that my dark marks are fading quicker and my skin is looking brought to. I have combination skin and find this serum does not add excess oil or make my skin dry. I like that the packaging states when to use it (morning and night ). It's gentle on my skin and doesn't irritate it at all. I don't need to use much as a little goes a long way. A lovely addition to my skincare routine.

I've tried many vitC products and don't really trust them. But this one is the best, with real effects. My scars and hyperpigmentation visibly improved so fast and my freckles are not as sharp as it is

Been using this for a month now as part of my skincare routine. I can't say I notice if this has made any difference to my skin or not really. It's quite drying to the skin when I put it on, I definitely feel the need to have moisturiser on straight after. Wouldn't buy it again
Although Ive been using the product for over a month I am not sure that I have noticed any visible difference in my skin.

Bought this to brighten my skin and felt Vit C would fit in with my regime. When I read the instructions inside the box it said to wait 10min before using moisturiser. I haven't got the time to wait in mornings. I can't use it at night because I use retinol and I don't want to only use retinol every other night. It's therefore been difficult to fit it in!
I usually get breakouts from vit c, but this worked like pure magic and did not cause me to break out.
I love this vitamin c so far, my skin feel brighter and it has help my scars fade away abit but I'm yet to see proper results as it hasn't been that long yet of using it.
I usually use in in the morning in combination with another serum. Tightens up your skin and makes you skin to shine.

I do notice when I forget to use this in the mornings. My skin seems smoother and better able to hold hydration with it on. I use this before the sunbright moisturizer daily. On my second bottle now so was worth me recording and I'm cheep :)
I love the glow this serum gives my skin. I have repurchased multiple times and I notice a difference in the brightness of my skin.
It's super light weight, perfect for oily skin. It has an amazing packaging so it doesn't oxidise.
I love this serum, it works, it also doesn't irritate or break me out

I use this as recommended by my beautician and have noticed an improvement in skin tone and a reduction of age related discolouration. It goes on easily and best of all doesn't stain my clothes or become oxidised before it's all used up.
I love all of the Inkey products I have gotten so far. I feel a new radiance on my face.
I like this serum, the texture is great. The packaging is a lot better than a dropper.
great serum, orange in colour, texture is it looks like a thin oil but it disappears on the skin so not oily
This serum is fantastic for giving my skin an instant glow and I find it's a great way of making my skin look healthy and glowing even without makeup
I've been trying to cut down the amount of products I use on my skin. Sometimes less is more. This is a must have in my routine.

avis.titre: This serum is a must-have in my routine!
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for over two years now, since my first skincare quiz. There's been a brief period when I decided to try other serums and stopped using it, only to miss it deeply. My skin is so much happier, brighter and healthier when I use it... I just can't go without it anymore!

avis.titre: Wish I could like it more
avis.texte: I use the Vitamin C in my morning routine and it takes a while to seep in. It also leaves skin feeling little sticky. I could see a difference with this Vitamin C serum.

Nice texture, absorbed well into the skin and wasn't sticky. Went well with my other skincare products and no problems applying makeup afterwards. Good for the price point as did see an improvement in brightness of skin but I do prefer other brands of vitamin c serum.

avis.titre: Best vit c on the market
avis.texte: I've tried different vit c serums and none comes close to this. Its in an airless pump, stabilized with EGF, it's affordable and most importantly, it's effective. Great value all round
This product helps to give my skin a brightening boost. love it!
I can't tell much difference with my skin with this serum! My only concern is it peels so much it you put makeup with it!
I am enjoying using this vitamin C serum. So much so that I already ordered another one. Great price point!
After 4 weeks, my skin looks brighter and my sunspots seem to be fading a bit. Also seems to be helping with fine lines and firming.
I really like this serum. It wears great under my make up! Will buy again!
The serum seemed slightly watery, but does the job and my skin looks brighter .

I began using this because it was highly recommended by an famous esthetician (BJM) who called Vit C one of the most important foundational pieces you can have in your skin care routine. I love using it and have had no problems even though my skin is sensitive. This is a winner

I have noticed changes on my acne scars and it has brightened skin plus I've noticed with other vitamin c serums for some reason it makes my skin extra oily throughout the day but this doesn't do that at all which I love .
The serum is very lightweight and absorbs quickly. My skin complexion has been bright and even, happy with the results!
It a good product for many, but the percentage it too high for my skin

This Vitamin-C is my favorite, and I have tried quite a few. The consistency is thin so it is easy to layer. I have been using it for about 3 months and my skin has definitely become more bright and less textured.
It takes time to build up on sensitive skin. I am not sure if it is working for me. I do not see particularly brightening on my skin, just redness. I use it 3x a week.
Like that it doesn't seem to dry out my skin... it leaves it feeling moisturized. I like that.
I started including this serum about a month ago to help brighten my skin. I haven't noticed too much of a difference but I believe in Inky products, so I am sure it'll do what it promises.
Used for some time but I don't see any visible resules unfortunately.
I like this item. I do prefer the vitamin c serum that is like a cream( thicker), personal preference but this is really smooth and feels nice.
It is a good product. Smooth, fresh. I do not see a lot of changes on the skin thi i have been using it for more than a year
Love the texture, it absorbs really fast and it doesn't smell. Love this product

avis.titre: It brightens gradually, but don't hold your breath
avis.texte: I've purchased this item now twice and I have not seen that much difference in brightening. I'm assuming this is gradual, but I'm not seeing any immediate results for skin to look less dull or to fade any acne spots. The pump bottle is a great design for it to pump to the skin or on the fingertips, but once the application of the serum is applied, skin just looks wet, and not as bright as I would like. I will give it one more go, but I'm not holding my breath.

I can really see my skin has become brighter and less blotchy since I started using this product, your skin gets very tight feeling after applying but once I apply my moisturiser & SPF after it feels great

avis.titre: The vitamin C that I keep coming back to
avis.texte: This vitamin C gives me great results. It is also incredibly reasonably priced, which is amazing.
I am thrilled, I really like this one, really great!! I ll buy it again ✔️ ✔️ ✔️ ✔️ ✔️
I have been using regularly and noticed some age patches on cheek has faded since using

avis.titre: Nice consistency, not the best for my skin type
avis.texte: It feels very nice on the skin, not too sticky. However I do not use it when I'm breaking out because I feel like it does not help. As a result I haven't been able to use it too consistently and therefore have not seen very noticeable results.
Since I've been more disciplined and used this every day the sun-darkened patches on my face have faded noticeably.
Feels great, not sticky. I have been using for 1 year and my skin glows.
This vitamin C did not irritate me at all, and is a part of my morning routine. I feel like it also made my pores appear smaller and skin glowier. It goes well under makeup

avis.titre: Best vitamin C on the market
avis.texte: I love this Vitamin C. It works great, it's affordable and it's in airless packaging.
